about: Measured from the render: x_world_measured / x_screen / y_screen are the centroid of the dog's composite matte read back from the canvas (camera undone for x_world_measured); head_* from the head element's matte. facing/posture/body/head are the drawings exposed. state switches at the measured onsets (rules in build/06_trace.py).

mapping.note: base screen: bx = X0 + K * x, by = FLOOR - K * y ; camera: screen = (b - (cam_cx, cam_cy)) * cam_z + (640, 360)
